data.one_liner: A lightweight media player with subtitle rendering and audio track switching support.
data.what_it_does: A media player widget and controller that supports subtitle rendering, audio track switching, and playback across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web by leveraging system or app-level components.
use_when: You need cross-platform video playback supporting Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
You require internal subtitle rendering and audio track switching features.
You want a drop-in widget or a custom video controller for media streaming.
avoid_when: Your project uses a Flutter version lower than 3.32.
You need DASH or MSS streaming support on iOS or macOS.
You are on Linux and cannot install `libmpv-dev`.
strengths: Complete platform coverage including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
Built-in internal subtitle rendering and audio track switching support.
Small, widget-first API with simple setup.
weaknesses: Requires specific native libraries on Linux (`libmpv-dev`) and Web (`ShakaPlayer`).
DASH and MSS are not supported by iOS/macOS backends.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.32+. Web projects require running `dart run video_view:webinit`. Linux requires `libmpv-dev` (or `mpv-libs-devel`). Web HLS/DASH support requires ShakaPlayer.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the official Flutter team's video playback plugin instead of a third-party package.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary focus is advanced audio playback and complex audio pipelines rather than video views.
